metric_scope: Static interpretation before new pixel outcomes; do not modify the frozen run
regular_grid_boundary_fields: The inherited regular_tile_boundary_gradient fields sample global512x384 grid lines. Subpatch grids restart inside each actual CI owner, so these are not exact statistics of every actual owner/subpatch seam.
all_image_gradient_max: luma gradient_error_max is measured over every horizontal and vertical adjacency of the assembled image, including actual CI and subpatch seams. It is a valid upper bound for the maximum on any seam subset when all compared components are finite.
do_not_claim: Do not call the regular-grid mean an exact actual-seam mean. Do not rename p99 or pass fractions as percent scene recovery. Native references and geometry checks are not a full semantic inverse or baked-camera ground truth.
next_estimate_stage: Declare actual seam masks from observed CI owner rectangles and local512x384 patch boundaries before inspecting inverse outputs; retain whole-image gradient metrics as well.
